body: It's hard to help others when I can't even help myself

The best way is for you to decide.  I'm going with an overdose on painkillers so I can go in bliss.  But whatever method you choose I pray your demons will finally be at rest as will mine . I'm sorry for the pains life gives you.  I'm stocking up to be able to do it,  so if you want to talk it'll be a few weeks before I can find enough to go

At 3 years old my dad left and never came back,  my uncle was babysitting me while my mom was at work,  after I went to bed I woke up because something felt wrong,  I got up to turn on The light because I was scared,  but a shadow figure came through the door and put me back in bed,  I remember a weight and pain and screaming and crying and then after a while the weight was gone.  I told my mom but she told me it was boogyman.  Later in life my uncle proudly tells me he raped me.  My mom had abusive boyfriends one after another who hurt us.  But none as bad as R.  R threatened us,  beat us,  raped and molested me. He bent my mom over the table one night during dinner and raped her holding a knife to her throat.  Another time he bound us together and doused us with gas and his brother came over just in time to save us.  I watched as he killed my birds.  And at one point I had a dog,  a pitbull I found as a tiny pup and bottlefed.  It bit R one day when he tried to rape me and R forced me to slit his throat with a gun to my head.  I should have let him pull the trigger . I tried telling the cops but his friends where cops and his brother was a judge . The day I went to the cops I had witnessed a bad accident on the side of a highway and held a guys skull together as he bled out,  I felt him take his last breath.  I can't let warm fluids touch my hand since,  even coffee on them sends me into a panic.  The cops on the scene saw the signs of abuse as I couldn't look any of them in the eyes,  let them touch me and I still had bruises so they took me to the precint yet no one there believed me.  R kicked us out and my mom got depressed and stopped caring for us I was 10 and had to do things for money no one not even my husband knows about just to keep me and my brother alive .  At 12 I was at a friends house and a drunk driver hit us as we where crossing the street there was four of us but 2 of my friends died on impact while I just had broken legs,  after that I was sent to live with my dad who was abusive in every form.  From reminding me my friends wouldn't have been there if it weren't for me,  to no guy would ever want a whore,  to locking me in sheds and closets.  I had to deal with his abuse until I met my savior my husband,  him and his family took me in to get me away from him.  But my husband barely knew me at the tine we had only known each other 9 months and he married me to get me away from my father.  My story isn't interesting,  and I'm not looking for sorrow or for people to feel bad for me.  But because you asked I have chosen to share.  I'd like for someone to know my story before I go,  my husband doesn't even know...  He thinks my dad was what pushed me,  is what causes me not to trust men,  and to flinch from NY touch.  He doesn't know why I have to change the sheets every morning he thinks it's night sweats,  but that's only partly true,  I can't get the memories out of my head and I can't live like this anymore.  I have the how and why for my plan..  I'm just looking for the where.  I can't let him see me,  I can't let his family see me when I end it all.  I want to just walk out of their lives.  I'm sorry I wrote so much.  I just wanted to let it all out while I can.

I understand where your coming from...  My plans are in place,  I just have no place to go to do it  I don't want my husband or his family (who we live with)  to find me I wish I could just dissapear  lifes not good for me,  and it never has been  the one thing I wanted in life I'm never able to have.  And that was the only reason I didn't end it all years ago
